_comment: rsi_mid phased grid. Phase 1 (entry) sweeps the RSI length whose UPWARD cross of 50 opens the trade (the midline itself is fixed). Phase 2 (trend) sweeps the trend EMA the close must sit above; 0 (no filter) is deliberately absent - the filter is mandatory. Phase 3 (exit) sweeps the upper band whose UPWARD cross closes the trade together with the number of consecutive bars below 50 after entry that also close it; the two exits interact, so they are swept jointly. Phase 4 (risk) sweeps the stop in daily ATR; 0 (no stop) is deliberately absent. DailyATRPeriod stays at its default and is NOT swept. RunPhases expands each phase over the previous phase's keepTop survivors: 5 + 5x5 + 5x30 + 5x5 = 205 combos. Judge on pooled OOS profit factor from a walk-forward, never on the in-sample best.
